newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 219 Kurd rebels in two months.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 219 Kurd rebels in two months.

text.p: Turkish security forces have killed 219 Kurdish rebels in clashes in southeast Turkey over the last two months, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Monday.
The agency said 72 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas were killed in the Iraqi border area where the rebels often stages attacks into Turkey from northern Iraq.
A further 147 guerrillas were killed in other parts of the southeast, the agency said. It did not give any figures for military casualties.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between the Turkish military and the PKK, which is fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
